assignments.reason: This node represents the Torah's practical instruction: come to the bar-da'at (master of knowledge) to hear Torah from his mouth. Its essential nature is the actualization of da'at through Torah spoken aloud — the very mechanism that Package 1 describes. The bar-da'at, Torah, and da'at-from-potential-to-actual are all core concepts of this package.

This node represents the outcome: being able to find one's match. Its essential nature is shidduch — the union of opposites mediated by da'at — which is the defining theme of Package 1. The shidduch is explicitly listed as a core node in this package, and this outcome node is its concrete realization.
